entries.task_id: warn|your|people before there comes to them a painful punishment
entries.description: Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment
entries.subject: Warn
entries.object: people before there comes to them a painful punishment

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ EN: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
[3] AR: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ EN: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

entries.task_id: allah|will|forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term
entries.description: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term
entries.subject: Allah
entries.object: forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term

spans.text: [4] AR: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ EN: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term.
[5] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا EN: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

entries.task_id: to them|and|[also] confided to them secretly
entries.description: to them and [also] confided to them secretly
entries.subject: to them

spans.text: [9] AR: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا EN: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
[10] AR: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا EN: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord.

entries.description: He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver
entries.subject: He

spans.text: Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

entries.task_id: he|will|send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
entries.description: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
entries.subject: He
entries.object: send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

spans.text: [11] AR: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا EN: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
[18] AR: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا EN: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

entries.task_id: in wealth|and|children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers
entries.description: in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers
entries.subject: in wealth
entries.object: children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers

spans.text: [12] AR: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا EN: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

entries.task_id: what|is|[the matter] with you that you do not attribute to allah [due] grandeur
entries.description: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
entries.subject: What
entries.object: [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

spans.text: [13] AR: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا EN: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

entries.description: While He has created you in stages?
entries.subject: While He

spans.text: [14] AR: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا EN: While He has created you in stages?

entries.task_id: how allah|has|created seven heavens in layers
entries.description: how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
entries.subject: how Allah

spans.text: [15] AR: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا EN: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

entries.task_id: light|and|made the sun a burning lamp?
entries.description: light and made the sun a burning lamp?
entries.subject: light
entries.object: made the sun a burning lamp?

spans.text: [16] AR: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا EN: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

entries.task_id: and allah|has|caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
entries.description: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
entries.subject: And Allah
entries.object: caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

spans.text: [17] AR: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا EN: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
[19] AR: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا EN: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

entries.task_id: disobeyed me|and|followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss
entries.description: disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss
entries.subject: disobeyed me
entries.object: followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss

spans.text: [21] AR: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا EN: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

entries.task_id: 'never leave|your|gods and never leave wadd or suwa' or yaghuth and ya'uq and nasr
entries.description: 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr
entries.subject: 'Never leave
entries.object: gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

spans.text: [23] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا EN: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

entries.description: were drowned and put into the Fire
entries.subject: were drowned

spans.text: [25] AR: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا EN: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

entries.task_id: they|will|mislead your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever
entries.description: they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever
entries.subject: they
entries.object: mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever

spans.text: [27] AR: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا EN: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
